name: last_band_distance_matrix_gemini_embed_001
caption: Last-band mean cosine-distance matrix among the ten domain seeds in gemini-embed-001. Diagonal cells are D_within (same seed, two stochastic replicates). Off-diagonal cells are mean last-band between-seed distance. Computed in the original embedding space; this is an occupancy map, not a cluster count.
alt_text: Last-band mean cosine-distance matrix among the ten domain seeds in gemini-embed-001. Diagonal cells are D_within (same seed, two stochastic replicates). Off-diagonal cells are mean last-band between-seed distance. Computed in the original embedding space; this is an occupancy map, not a cluster count.
limitations: A large off-diagonal distance means two locked trajectories sit apart in this representation. It does not recover the seed, name a semantic state, or transfer to another embedding. Twin pairs are excluded so they cannot shrink D_between. gemini-embed-001 is closed; this panel cannot alone prove architecture-independence.
